messages.content: You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
In which numeric precision must training run on this host, and which must it never use?
Training must run in **bf16**, and it must never be **fp16**.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
On what kind of base must adapters be served, and what happens over a q4 base?
Adapters must be served on an fp16 or high-precision base. On a q4 quantized base, a bf16-trained adapter loses its deltas over the four-bit weights and confabulates.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
Why must Ollama generations never run while training?
Ollama generations must never run while training because the two fight for the same eight-gigabyte card.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
In QLoRA, which layers must never leave the GPU, and which big pieces go to the CPU?
The NF4-quantized layers must never leave the GPU, while the big unquantized pieces — embed_tokens (and its tied lm_head), and the vision and audio embeddings — go to the CPU.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
Who executes weight training, and what does the runtime do instead?
Weight training is operator-executed, while the runtime assembles, gates, versions, and records.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
During which hours does the school day run, and who set that window?
The school day runs from 09:00 to 14:00 local time, and the window was set by the operator.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
What is the re-quiz spacing ladder?
The re-quiz spacing follows a ladder of one day, then three, seven, fourteen, and thirty days.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
How many times at most is a lesson drilled in one day?
A lesson is not drilled more than three times in one day.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
Which actions does the school day surface but never take?
The school day features several "gated actions" that are never taken: consolidation, adapter activation, approval decisions, supersession resolution, and training.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
What does a re-run of a passed lesson show for chunks written, and why?
A re-run shows zero chunks written because the memories are already in the room.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
What happens to private subjects' knowledge — does it leave the machine?
Private knowledge never leaves this machine.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
What are the eight steps of self-modification, in order?
The eight steps of self-modification are: proposal, backup, patch, syntax check, tests, health check, review, and promote or rollback.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
What increments the patch number, and what increments the minor number?
Within an epoch, each shippable milestone increments the patch number, and crossing into a new epoch increments the minor number.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
What does scripts/check_versions.py read, and when does it fail?
It reads the declared Release from docs/architecture/versioning.md and fails if any component source disagrees.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
What must be attached to every GitHub release?
A freshly rebuilt installer zip.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
What must never be committed?
According to the notes, you must never commit **secrets, model weights, virtual environments, caches, or private databases**.
You are 0M3-G4-ARC. Answer from your studied knowledge.
What are the authoritative documents for decisions?
The authoritative documents are the architecture decision records, the Covenant, the Constitution, and the Charter.
